baseline_descriptions.static_classical: B1: Static Classical (ECDH). Strictly Classical key exchange; rejects non-classical requests and rejects flows where policy floor requires Hybrid or PQC.
baseline_descriptions.static_hybrid: B2: Static Hybrid (X25519 + ML-KEM). Fixed hybrid mode; rejects non-hybrid requests and rejects flows requiring PQC floor.
baseline_descriptions.static_pqc: B3: Static PQC (ML-KEM). Fixed pure post-quantum mode; rejects non-PQC requests and fails constrained devices unable to support PQC wire sizes or memory.
baseline_descriptions.sensitivity_only: B4: Sensitivity-Only. Enforces policy floor strictly by sensitivity tier, but disables all cause-classified recovery adaptations (no MTU fragmentation hints or backoff).
baseline_descriptions.downgrade_on_failure: B5: Downgrade-on-Failure. Naive industry fallback that steps down cryptographic mode to maintain connectivity upon failure, deliberately violating the security floor.
baseline_descriptions.static_retry_with_floor: B6: Static Retry with Floor. Enforces security floor, but retries blindly without classifying fault cause or adapting MTU packet size.
baseline_descriptions.full_gateway: B7: Full QERIS Gateway. Dynamic signed policy floor, pure deterministic readiness, S3 cause-classified recovery, adaptive MTU fragmentation, and DEC-4 epoch guards.
